dataset: TU-Braunschweig Database of 3D Concrete Printed Buildings
attribution: Placzek, G. (2024). Database of 3D Concrete Printed Buildings [Dataset]. Zenodo. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14214812. CC BY 4.0. Data collection: M. Dahlberg.
country: International catalogue (compiled at TU Braunschweig, Germany)
storage_medium: single flat table (.xlsx), one row per built project, 22 project/process categories

fidelity.method: project/process-layer catalogue — no mix/strength data; no mix-fidelity score (a layer beyond the current flat mix schema)

build_cmd: python build/extract.py <Database_3D-printed-buildings.xlsx downloaded from the DOI>
